text: As the Toronto Transit Commission (TTC) operates a transit service on Bathurst Street, City Council approval of this report is required. Transportation Services is requesting approval from City Council to install traffic control signals at the intersection of Bathurst Street and Wellington Street West. This installation is justified based on the technical requirements and will provide improved safety for pedestrians, cyclists and motorists at this intersection.

City Council on November 26 and 27, 2019, adopted the following: 1. City Council authorize the installation of traffic control signals at the intersection of Bathurst Street and Wellington Street West. 2.
